Generated Narrative: ConceptMap NgHivLocalToWHOHiv

Mapping from NG HIV Local Concepts to Nigeria Relevant WHO HIV Concepts


Group 1 Mapping from NG HIV Follow Up Status CodeSystem to Nigeria Local WHO HIV Concepts

Source CodeRelationshipTarget CodeComment
lost (Lost to follow-up)is equivalent toHIV.H.DE42 (Lost to follow-up)
to (Transfer out)is equivalent toHIV.H.DE43 (Transferred out)
deadnarrowerHIV.H.DE44 (Death (documented))WHO requires documented death; the local Dead concept does not itself assert documentation.
restartis equivalent toHIV.D.DE45 (Restarting ART)
stop (Stopped treatment)is equivalent toHIV.D.DE40 (Stopped ART)
stop (Stopped treatment)narrowerHIV.H.DE45 (Refused (stopped) treatment)To add details later
alive-on-artis equivalent toHIV.H.DE47 (On ART)

Group 2 Mapping from NG HIV-ARV Adherence CodeSystem to Nigeria Local WHO HIV Concepts

Source CodeRelationshipTarget CodeComment
Stoppedmaps loosely toHIV.D.DE40 (Stopped ART)The local code is used in an adherence/status context, while the WHO concept explicitly represents ART treatment status.

Group 3 Mapping from HIV DSD - Reason For Category Change CodeSystem to Nigeria Local WHO HIV Concepts

Source CodeRelationshipTarget CodeComment
DeadnarrowerHIV.H.DE44 (Death (documented))WHO requires documented death; the local Dead concept is broader.
Lostis equivalent toHIV.H.DE42 (Lost to follow-up)
TOis equivalent toHIV.H.DE43 (Transferred out)

Group 4 Mapping from NG HIV Positive Tracking to Nigeria Local WHO HIV Concepts

Source CodeRelationshipTarget CodeComment
Not-Started (ART Not Started)is equivalent toHIV.H.DE4 (Did not initiate ART)
Started-ARTnarrowerHIV.D.DE382 (ART initiated within 7 days of diagnosis)WHO is narrower because it requires ART initiation within 7 days of diagnosis; the local code does not specify timing.
Linked-To-Care (Linked to care and treatment)narrowerHIV.B.DE147 (Linked to enrolment in care and ART initiation)WHO additionally specifies enrolment in care and ART initiation; the local linkage concept is broader.
Final-Outcomemaps loosely toHIV.H.DE41 (HIV Treatement outcome)The local concept identifies a final tracking outcome, while WHO identifies the HIV treatment outcome data element.

Group 5 Mapping from HIV - Final Outcome CodeSystem to Nigeria Local WHO HIV Concepts

Source CodeRelationshipTarget CodeComment
lost-to-follow-upis equivalent toHIV.H.DE42 (Lost to follow-up)
diednarrowerHIV.H.DE44 (Death (documented))WHO requires documented death; the local Died concept is broader.
declinednarrowerHIV.H.DE45 (Refused (stopped) treatment)WHO specifically represents refusal with stopped treatment; the local Declined outcome is broader.
started-artnarrowerHIV.D.DE382 (ART initiated within 7 days of diagnosis)WHO is narrower because it limits initiation to within 7 days of diagnosis.
confirmed-referralmaps loosely toHIV.H.DE49 (Transfer confirmed)The local concept represents a confirmed referral, while WHO represents a confirmed transfer.

Group 6 Mapping from HIV - Reason Not Started ART CodeSystem to Nigeria Local WHO HIV Concepts

Source CodeRelationshipTarget CodeComment
declinednarrowerHIV.D.DE371 (Patient self-reported as not ready/willing)WHO specifically states that the patient self-reported not being ready or willing; the local Declined category is broader.
on-adherence-preparationmaps loosely toHIV.D.DE372 (Not completed education, support and preparation for ART)Both refer to preparation before ART initiation, but the local status and WHO reason-for-delay concepts are not identical.
known-positive-on-art (Known +ve on ART)maps to wider conceptHIV.H.DE47 (On ART)WHO On ART is broader because it does not additionally encode the local known-positive context.
on-oi-managementnarrowerHIV.D.DE377 (Patient diagnosed with cryptococcal meningitis)Cryptococcal meningitis is one specific reason within the broader local On OI management category. Do not automatically select this target without diagnosis context.
on-oi-managementnarrowerHIV.D.DE378 (Patient diagnosed with histoplasmosis)Histoplasmosis is one specific reason within the broader local On OI management category. Do not automatically select this target without diagnosis context.
other (Other Specify here)is equivalent toHIV.D.DE380 (Other)

Group 7 Mapping from Target Population Category Codes to Nigeria Local WHO HIV Concepts

Source CodeRelationshipTarget CodeComment
Female-Commercial-Sex-Workersmaps to wider conceptHIV.B.DE51 (Sex worker)WHO Sex worker is broader because it is not restricted to female sex workers.
MSMis equivalent toHIV.B.DE52 (Men who have sex with men)WHO includes both trans and gender-diverse people; the local TG category is narrower.
TGmaps to wider conceptHIV.B.DE53 (Trans and gender-diverse people)
People-Who-Inject-Drugis equivalent toHIV.B.DE54 (People who inject drugs)
OVC-AIDS-Orphaned (OVC or AIDS Orphaned)maps to wider conceptHIV.B.DE58 (Orphan or vulnerable child)WHO Orphan or vulnerable child is broader than the local HIV/AIDS-oriented OVC category.

Group 8 Mapping from TB TPT Prophylaxis Type Codes to Nigeria Local WHO HIV Concepts

Source CodeRelationshipTarget CodeComment
inhmaps loosely toHIV.D.DE250 (Provide isoniazid preventive therapy)The local code identifies isoniazid prophylaxis type; WHO represents the action of providing isoniazid preventive therapy.

Group 9 Mapping from Enhanced Adherence Counselling to Nigeria Local WHO HIV Concepts

Source CodeRelationshipTarget CodeComment
eac (Enhanced Adherence Counselling)maps loosely toHIV.D.DE496 (Enhanced adherence counselling provided)The local concept identifies enhanced adherence counselling; WHO explicitly represents that counselling was provided.
